scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w tools/simulator
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w tools/simulator
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w tools/simulator
